SELECT handle.id AS group_link_id, a.id AS account_id, a.account_group_id, participant.presence_status, CASE WHEN participant.presence_status != 1 THEN NULL WHEN profile.announce_only = 0 THEN TRUE WHEN profile.announce_only = 1 AND participant.role IN (2,3) THEN TRUE WHEN profile.announce_only = 1 AND participant.role = 1 THEN FALSE ELSE NULL END AS message_send_allowed, CASE WHEN s.login_state = 1 AND s.account_state IN (2,6,7) AND (s.risk_status IS NULL OR s.risk_status = 1) AND (s.mute_status IS NULL OR s.mute_status = 2) AND a.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.protocol_account_id) != '' AND a.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(a.ws_phone) != '' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS online, a.protocol_id, CASE WHEN profile.banned = 1 THEN FALSE WHEN profile.banned = 0 THEN TRUE ELSE NULL END AS group_available, CASE WHEN participant.presence_status = 1 AND participant.role IN (2,3) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS admin FROM group_link handle JOIN wa_account_group_binding binding ON binding.tenant_id=handle.tenant_id AND binding.group_id=handle.group_id JOIN wa_group_participant participant ON participant.tenant_id=binding.tenant_id AND participant.group_id=binding.group_id AND participant.id=binding.participant_id JOIN account a ON a.tenant_id=binding.tenant_id AND a.id=binding.account_id AND a.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN account_state s ON s.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND s.account_id=a.id LEFT JOIN wa_group_profile profile ON profile.tenant_id=handle.tenant_id AND profile.group_id=handle.group_id WHERE handle.deleted_at IS NULL AND handle.id IN #{id} AND (a.account_group_id=#{accountGroupId} OR (participant.presence_status=1 AND participant.role IN (2,3))
OR a.id IN #{id} ) ORDER BY handle.id, a.id
